title: Slate's Sure Thing Charters

services.name: Fishing Charter
services.desc: From calm family outings to big-time catches, our guided charters deliver fun, fish, and fantastic views on the St. Lawrence River. Your trip includes everything you need to fish like a pro-except your fishing license, which you’ll need to bring along. Dress for the weather, pack sunscreen and snacks, and don’t forget your camera! Capt. John also offers classic shore dinners upon request. Just show up ready to fish, laugh, and create memories your family will talk about for years. Chartering with Capt.
